title: Long-time Bills radio voice John Murphy believes he lost credential over criticism of Joe Brady

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Long-time Bills radio voice John Murphy believes he lost credential over criticism of Joe Brady
sources.description: In an age of sports media that features plenty of reporters and analysts who are on the payroll, directly or indirectly, of the teams and/or leagues they cover, some teams and leagues feel emboldened to take action against those who dare to cover them with scrutiny or criticism.
